codeSystems.name: AtPrenudgeCodeSystemAthisSmoking
codeSystems.title: AT PreNUDGE ATHIS Smoking Answer Codes
codeSystems.description: Local answer codes for ATHIS smoking questionnaire items used in the PreNUDGE smoking status questionnaire. These codes preserve the questionnaire semantics and are mapped to SNOMED CT only where a clinical smoking-status Observation is derived.
